CustomField.label: Promotion Level
CustomField.description: Tier of this environment in the promotion pipeline (1 = lowest / dev). Orgs that share a level are peers on the same level — e.g. several Dev orgs that all feed one UAT are all level 1. A promote flows to the next level up; back-capture flows down to the level below. Use Promotes_To__c to override the next target for exceptions (a hotfix org straight to Prod, or a level that fans out to two targets).
